sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: economy of material and sculptural presence meet in this lounge chair, designed by Anne-mette Bartholin and Morten Ernst for furniture brand Cozmo. The Gingko lounge chair is the product of a simple gesture, where a 2D shape is turned into a 3D object using as little material as possible.
